insights: **Weekly Highlights —** The Gourmet Popcorn Gift Set led the week at $15,671 (+39.6%) on 315 units (+40.0%), with conversion up to 14.2%. The Flavor-Wrapped Microwave Popcorn Kit grew to $7,748 (+29.2%) as its CVR climbed +52.8% to 11.7%, and the Super Butter Flavor-Wrapped 6 Sachets rose to $3,540 (+35.5%). Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $8,110, and total sales reached $47,332 on 1676 units.

**Metrics to Watch —** The -10.5% easing in total sales (from $52,866 to $47,332) was primarily driven by lower ad spend of $3,624 (prior $4,416), which brought PPC revenue to $14,051 (-21.9%). Organic revenue held at $33,280 (-4.6%), a much smaller move than paid. The Pop Cups Super Butter 6-Pack eased to $6,699 (-20.7%) on sessions down -26.5%, yet its conversion improved to 31.3% (+9.7%), so shoppers who reach the page are buying. We are focused on bringing more traffic back to Pop Cups to restore its volume.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS improved to 7.7% from 8.35%, so advertising is taking a smaller share of total sales. ROAS came in at 3.88x (prior 4.07x) with ACOS at 25.8%, a 0.70% ad CTR and a 14.77% ad conversion rate. Spend is now being directed toward the SKUs that are converting best, with the goal of lifting ROAS back above 4.07x.

**Actions This Week —** Increase bids and budget on the Pop Cups Super Butter 6-Pack's top search terms to win back sessions while its 31.3% conversion holds. Scale campaigns for the Gourmet Popcorn Gift Set and the Flavor-Wrapped Microwave Popcorn Kit, the two fastest-growing SKUs, heading into the holiday season. Trim low-converting search terms to keep ACOS at or below 25.8% while spend is rebuilt.
